projectDescription: An Android app to catalog and manage your personal book and comics collection, with barcode scanning, multi-source metadata lookup, and Calibre sync.
keyFeatures: Add books by barcode scan, ISBN lookup, or free-text search
Fetch metadata from 20+ international data sources (Amazon, Google Books, OpenLibrary, ISFDB, Goodreads, BnF, DNB, and more)
Organize books across multiple virtual bookshelves
Customizable booklist styles with flexible grouping (author, series, genre, date read, etc.)
Track reading status and reading progress (page / percentage)
Cover image management with multi-source browser
Import from Book Catalogue and other sources
Support for books and European comics (Bedetheque, StripInfo, LastDodo)
20+ UI languages with Weblate translation support
publicApiSurface: SearchEngine interface (ByIsbn, ByText, ByExternalId, CoverByEdition sub-interfaces)
EngineId — registry of all search engine identifiers
Book entity — primary data model with DBKey field constants
Author, Series, Publisher, Bookshelf, TocEntry entities
DataWriter / DataReader interfaces — pluggable archive format support
RecordType enum — supported record types in archives
BooklistGroup / GroupKey — booklist grouping and style system
Style / UserStyle / BuiltinStyle — list display style configuration
ServiceLocator — app-wide dependency injection entry point
DBKey — canonical database and bundle key constants
